title: 1985 night encounter: 'my god, bugs'
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of 1985 night encounter: 'my god, bugs', about 1985 at Strieber's cabin, upstate New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: My immediate thought was, my god, bugs.

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer who described his experiences with strange beings in a book called Communion, says that one night in 1985 at his cabin in upstate New York he came face to face with them. He says his immediate thought was, "my god, bugs." He tells it as part of his account of contact with non-human beings.
